summary:
Builds clean.

- `src/pages/Login.jsx`: added a "Forgot password?" link under the password field, pointing at `/reset-password`.
- `src/pages/ResetPassword.jsx` (new): email + new password + confirm form. It reuses the existing `PASSWORD_RULES` from the sign-up page (now exported from `src/pages/Signup.jsx`), so the same five rules are listed and highlighted on submit; then checks the passwords match, then that an account with that email exists, updates the stored password via `saveUser`, and navigates to `/login`.
- `src/App.jsx`: registered the `/reset-password` route.
- `src/style.css`: right-aligned the forgot-password line.

Reading taken: the smaller one — a direct reset page against the existing demo localStorage account store, matching how login/signup already work, with no email-token flow (that would be a backend concern and lives in the separate backend repository).
blockers: Not applied -- Emailing a reset token / verifying a reset link: Not asked for by the instruction (the page takes email + new password directly), and any token issuing/verification belongs to the backend repository
conventions: Password rules are a single shared list (PASSWORD_RULES exported from src/pages/Signup.jsx): at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, one special character. Any form that sets a password must list them under the password field and, on submit, replace each unmet rule's label with its specific error message in red.
Password validation runs before the confirm-match check, which runs before any account lookup check.
Pages live in src/pages/<Name>.jsx and are registered by path in the routes map in src/App.jsx.

visual_check.evidence: The login page shows a 'Forgot password?' link under the password field, and /reset-password renders a 'Reset your password' card with Email, New password (with the five password rules), Confirm new password, a Reset password button and a back-to-login link.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API: all persistence is client-side via src/store.js (localStorage key 'acme-users', sessionStorage key 'acme-current') exposing findUser(email), saveUser(user), setCurrentUser(email), currentUser(). Client routes in src/App.jsx are '/signup', '/login', '/welcome', '/reset-password' (unknown paths fall back to Signup); PASSWORD_RULES ids are 'length', 'upper', 'lower', 'number', 'special' and are exported from src/pages/Signup.jsx and reused by ResetPassword.jsx.
